column2: Because I'm always putting up a brave front...
only when I was with you could I lean on someone...
it feels like a feeling I'd forgotten is coming back to life!
Even if everyone comes to hate me, this feeling...
I want to stay together forever!
When I saw you $$大ケガ$$, I thought my heart would break...
I'd have to keep living with my real self hidden...
As long as you're beside me,
I... I don't need anything else!
For you... I can do anything.
Even if that means being charged with any $$大罪$$...
